title: PROJECT CHANGE: EFSB02-2B/EFSB07-8A Companies file project change petition in connection with a transmission line project previously approved by the Siting Board; specifically, the petition pertains to proposed modifications to an existing NSTAR switching station in the Town of Barnstable where the previously approved transmission lines are intended to connect to the regional electric grid

milestones.detail: : Certification of Administrative Record, filed with the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court, March 10, 2015, include: Transmittal letter, to Maura S. Doyle, Clerk, Supreme Judicial Court, from M. Kathryn Sedor, Esq., MA Energy Facilities Siting Board, dated March 10, 2015; Certification of Administrative Record, signed by M. Kathryn Sedor, dated March 10, 2015; Letter to Mark D. Marini, Secretary, MA Department of Public Utilities, from David S. Rosenzweig, Esq., dated December 19, 2014; and EFSB Service List for the appeal, dated March 10, 2015. Also attached is the EFSB Email Service List for the appeal, dated March 10, 2015. Please note that earlier documents may have incorrectly identified the docket number of the appeal as SJ-2014-508. The attached documents contain the correct docket number, SJ-2014-0508.
